title: The cumulant IS the char-p energy DEFECT and the defect is NEGATIVE
evidence: Exact integer probes scripts/probes/_407_conn/C040_defect_sign.py and C040_crux.py (r-fold convolution counts for E_r^{Fq}, brute unit-circle counts for E_r^{C}; sympy unused, plain Fraction). TWO independent refutations. (1) PREMISE IS A BOOKKEEPING ERROR. C040 claims 'defect negative: n=16,r=5 E_5=5.17e8 < E_5^C=9.91e8'. The TRUE char-0 energy is E_5^C = 514,031,616 = 5.14e8; the value 9.91e8 = 990,904,320 is EXACTLY the Gaussian baseline (2r-1)!!*n^r, NOT E_5^C. So C040 compared E^{Fq} to the BASELINE and mislabeled it E^C. The actual defect D_5 = E_5^{Fq}-E_5^C is POSITIVE (~5.17e8-5.14e8>0), not negative. (2) DEFECT SIGN ACROSS THE PRIZE REGIME (proper subgroup mu_n, large prime, n<<sqrt q, beta=4-5): exact D_r = E_r^{Fq}-E_r^{C} is 0 or POSITIVE in EVERY tested row, never negative. n=8 beta4(p=4129)/beta5(p=32801): D_r=0 all r. n=16 beta4(p=65537): D_4=+4480, D_5=+2,923,920 (the W-anomaly onset at r>r_max~5, exactly as CharSumMomentDeepWall predicts). n=16 beta5(p=1048609): D_r=0 for r<=5 (larger prime pushes wall out). n=32 same pattern. (3) THE REFRAMING BUYS NOTHING. E_r^C/baseline is ALREADY <=1 in char 0 for every r (n=8: 1.0->0.13; n=16: 1.0->0.52), so GaussianEnergyBound E_r<=(2r-1)!!n^r holds in char 0 DIRECTLY -- the moment bound never needed any n^{2r} subtraction. Subtracting n^{2r} (the fixed b=0 term) cannot change where E_r sits; kap_r/qbase<=1 is just E_r/baseline<=1 minus n^{2r}/(q*baseline), a trivial restatement. When the char-p defect turns POSITIVE (the W-anomaly), the cumulant kappa_r=q*E_r-n^{2r} inherits it verbatim: at n=16 beta4 r=5 the positive defect raises B_ach. The achievable B=(q*E_r-n^{2r})^{1/2r} is still gated on validating E_r at the char-0 value to depth r~ln q -- the open BGK/Paley square-root-cancellation wall, unchanged.
honest_note: The off-diagonal identity sum_{b!=0}|eta_b|^{2r}=q*E_r-n^{2r} is correct and machine-verified (it is the standard Parseval moment identity; the 'n*' prefactor in the C040 record is spurious). What is refuted is (a) the empirical premise that the char-p energy defect is negative in the prize regime -- it is 0 or positive -- and (b) the structural claim that subtracting n^{2r} first dissolves the W-anomaly. The 'cumulant' here is the off-diagonal MOMENT sum (subtract the b=0 raw term), NOT the connected statistical cumulant; prior probes (_wf407_cumulant_connected.py) already found the connected-cumulant route inherits the defect too. This refutation should go to DISPROOF_LOG. Scope: probes go to n=32, beta<=5, primes up to ~6e6; the prize n=2^30 is unreachable by exact enumeration, but the sign of the defect and the E_r^C<=baseline fact are structural (Lam-Leung char-0) and the small-n behavior is the controlled regime. No closure of the open core is claimed or possible from this connection.
